page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Right margin holds the marginal notes "Hieronymi-mus." and the "»" quotation marks beside lines 3 to 4 and 9 to 12. The left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Page number at the head. Signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: ut gratia Dei dicatur causa, & fidei, & dilectionis nostra. etsi ratio repugnet: quia amoris Unigeniti, seu fidei in ipsum, praemium dicitur gratia data.

Nec Hieronymi hoc (Ex Dei praescientia evenit, ut, quem scit justum futurum, priùs diligat, quàm oriatur ex utero) repudiamusHieronymi-mus.: modò causa dilectionis non statuatur, praescientia ullius in nobis futuri boni. Hoc enim jam Pelagianum, vel Semi-pelagianum esse, restat nobis, quando ipse ita vult, ostendere.»
Augustinus, lib. de Praedest. Sanct. c.»

1. Adhuc in quaestione de praedestinatione Sanctorum caligant, (scilicet Massilienses, de quorum haeretica doctrinâ, consultus à Prospero & Hilario, respondet.) Retenta ergo ista, in quae pervenerunt, (1. Pecca-to primi hominis obnoxium nasci genus humanum: nec ab isto malo, nisi per justitiam secundi hominis, aliquem liberari. 2. Praeveniri hominum voluntates Dei gratiâ: quia ad nullum opus bonum, vel incipiendum, vel perficiendum, sibi quisquâ sufficere possit.)»

page.notes: Left margin strip is the neighbouring page's edge, not transcribed. Right-margin "»" marks are transcribed as notes; their exact placement in the scan is approximate. The margin note "Hieronymi-mus." is set in small type and read as one word split across two lines.
